components.text:
Mandrakes are a group of perennial herbaceous plants with long, parsnip shaped roots.

If agitated, mandrakes will scream causing injury or even death. Wearing $(el:getting_started/earmuffs)$(b)earmuffs(/b)$(el) can protect you, and they sleep at night.

$(b)Procurement:$()
Dropped by tall and short grass. Has a chance to spawn a Mandrake when harvested.
